title: Forum non conveniens
summary: Forum non conveniens permits dismissal in favor of an available adequate alternative forum when the governing balance strongly favors litigation there. It often matters when transfer within the federal system cannot reach the alternative forum.
notes: Less favorable substantive law does not alone make the alternative inadequate. The possibility that no meaningful remedy exists is a different question. Dismissal, transfer, and enforcement of a forum clause have related but distinct frameworks.

sections.Meaning: Forum non conveniens permits dismissal in favor of an available adequate alternative forum when the governing balance strongly favors litigation there. It often matters when transfer within the federal system cannot reach the alternative forum.
sections.How to work through the question: Identify an available adequate alternative, evaluate the private and public interests, and explain the weight due the plaintiff’s forum choice. Piper considers foreign plaintiffs, an overseas accident, evidence and witnesses abroad, and the adequacy of the Scottish forum.
